# Test pe cache commands - verifiable shared caching

# Basic cache operations
pe cache status
stdout 'Cache Status:'
stdout 'Entries: 0'

# Run with caching
env PE_TEST_MODE=true
pe run 'What is 2+2?' --provider mock
stdout '4'

# Check cache was populated
pe cache status
stdout 'Cache Status:'
stdout 'Entries:'

# List cache entries
pe cache list
stdout 'Cache entries:'

# Clear cache
pe cache clear --force
stdout 'Cache cleared'

# Verify cache is empty
pe cache status
stdout 'Entries: 0'

# Show cache statistics
pe cache stats
stdout 'Cache statistics:'
stdout 'Total entries: 0'

# Export cache (when populated)
env PE_TEST_MODE=true
pe run 'Test prompt' --provider mock
stdout 'Mock response'
pe cache export cache-export.tar.gz
stdout 'Exported cache bundle'
exists cache-export.tar.gz

# Import cache
pe cache clear --force
stdout 'Cache cleared'
pe cache import cache-export.tar.gz
stdout 'Imported'

# Verify cache
pe cache verify
stdout 'Cache Verification Results:'
stdout 'Valid:'
